Barboach

Water Ground

Hoenn · Generation 3

Barboach is a Water/Ground-type Whiskers Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 1.9 kg. It evolves into Whiscash. Its highest base stat is Speed (60), with a base stat total of 288.
